summary: Sequential-init + joint-polish hybrid at BLOCKS=[1,4,7], K=512. Combines cycle 215 sequential protocol (phase 1, LR=1e-4, 2000 steps/block) with lower-LR joint Adam polish on all 3 blocks' W_out+b_out (phase 2, LR=5e-5, 1000 steps). 3 seeds.

soundness.phase2_lr_rationale: 5e-5 (half of phase 1) appropriate for polish, unlikely to wipe sequential basin
soundness.collapse_handling: explicit rollback + honest reporting per fallback section

thresholds.assessment: refute band correctly anchored to joint-alone floor

risks: phase 2 may degrade phase 1 if LR still too high for 3-block joint basin — mitigated by best-tracking + rollback
gain may be within noise of cycle 215's std (0.047) — 3 seeds adequate but not decisive
notes: Ensure phase 2 best-state comparison spans both phases (tracks phase-1 best as baseline), so a worse phase 2 is detectable per seed.
